claims: An ad running unchanged for months is a strong signal the concept works
The skill finds longest-running concepts and breaks down hook, format, messaging angle, CTA
'Thousands of people' have gone through the 30-day challenge
how_to_steps: Open Meta Ads Library and search a competitor brand (e.g. Vuori)
Give the skill your competitor list; it pulls their ads and sorts by run length
It breaks down each long-running ad: hook, format, messaging angle, CTA
Give it your brand info; it outputs ad concepts and creative briefs to test
on_screen_only: Hook card: 'Steal this AI Skill from me if you run ads'
Meta Ads Library UI: United States, All ads, search 'Vuori', tabs Ad Library / Ad Library Report / Ad Library API / Branded Content; ad cards 'Started running on Feb 14, 2026'

SKILL.md excerpt (partial): 'Do NOT add weight for the "This ad has multiple versions" label... That usually means Dynamic Creative or placement customization'; 'Lower the weight when: UTM clues or copy suggest a retargeting ad... it is a pure brand ad from a very large company that can afford to leave anything running'; 'Give each ad a signal score from 1 to 5 and rank the ledger by it'; 'Do pass (only if the competitor runs in the EU): ads delivered in the EU show estimated reach plus age, gender and country breakdown'; 'Say these caveats in the report: a start date shows how long... not that it made money; Library shows ad spend, cl... commercial ads; long runners can be small...'
